title: Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (Full Remote)(H/F/X)
description:
Aperçu de l’entreprise
TMC est un cabinet de conseil de premier plan spécialisé dans la fourniture de connaissances spécialisées en physique, logiciel, nanotechnologie et science des données. Nous permettons aux entreprises d’innover et de garder une longueur d’avance sur le marché concurrentiel en tirant parti des technologies de pointe et des progrès scientifiques.
Titre du poste
Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (H/F/X)
Localisation
Full Remote, Europe
Nous recherchons un ingénieur spécialisé dans l'intégration de composants haute tension pour rejoindre notre équipe. Votre rôle consistera à développer et à intégrer des composants électriques de haute tension dans nos produits, en assurant leur conformité aux normes et spécifications techniques.
En tant qu'ingénieur en intégration de composants haute tension, vous serez responsable des tâches suivantes :

• Créer une fiche produit pour les nouveaux composants haute tension (HV) : Il s'agit de créer une documentation décrivant les spécifications, les caractéristiques et d'autres informations pertinentes sur les composants haute tension à intégrer.

• Réaliser des examens/révisions techniques : Effectuer des examens techniques approfondis pour s'assurer que l'intégration des composants haute tension répond à toutes les normes, exigences et règles de sécurité nécessaires.

• Élaborer des lignes directrices pour l'installation : Élaborer des lignes directrices détaillées pour l'installation de chaque composant haute tension, couvrant à la fois les interfaces mécaniques et électriques. En outre, créer des documents d'interface fonctionnelle pour garantir une intégration transparente dans l'architecture fonctionnelle globale.

• Suivi des activités fournisseurs : Suivre les activités des fournisseurs, y compris leurs plans de développement, leurs plans de validation de la conception et tous les problèmes qui se posent, ainsi que les plans d'action correspondants pour les résoudre.

• Diffusion de la documentation : Vous serez responsable de la diffusion de la documentation 3D des composants aux parties concernées.

• Créer des spécifications de dessin en 2D : Générer des spécifications de dessin 2D détaillées qui soulignent les dimensions précises, les tolérances et les autres spécifications nécessaires à la fabrication et à l'assemblage.

• Effectuer une analyse des modes de défaillance et de leurs effets (DFMEA) : Réaliser l'AMDE pour identifier et atténuer les modes de défaillance potentiels et leurs effets sur la conception et la fonctionnalité des composants haute tension.

• Soutien aux activités de sign-off et de PEA (Product Engineering Authorization) : Vous apporterez un soutien technique aux activités de sign-off et de PEA , assurer toutes les approbations nécessaires avant et/ou après implémentation (intégration)

En accomplissant ces tâches, vous garantirez l'intégration réussie des composants haute tension dans les projets et les lignes de produits spécifiés, tout en accordant la priorité à la sécurité, à la fonctionnalité et à la conformité aux normes et réglementations en vigueur.
Compétences requises :

• Diplôme d'ingénieur en électrotechnique, génie électrique ou domaine similaire.

• Bonne compréhension des concepts de haute tension et des normes associées.

• Expérience dans le développement et l'intégration de composants électriques.

• Compétences en analyse de risques (DFMEA).

• Capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement.

• Rigueur et souci du détail.

Renseignements supplémentaires
Pour plus de détails sur le rôle, les responsabilités et les qualifications, les candidats intéressés sont invités à visiter la page carrières TMC. Nous sommes un employeur équitable et valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise.

title: Influencer Manager, Social & Culture
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a creator- and culture-obsessed Influencer Manager to build and own our influencer practice from the ground up. You’ll sit on the Social & Culture team and will be the owner of influencer at Lyft across critical initiatives. This role is for you if you can spot a viral creator on Monday, close the deal on Tuesday, then launch on Wednesday-and turn the relationship into something we can ignite again in a month. 

You’ll work in close partnership with our Global Growth, Brand, Product Marketing, Legal, and Business Affairs teams, as well as our creator agency partners and production teams. You’ll also be Lyft’s go-to expert on creator work, building the playbook, setting the benchmarks, and helping teams across the company understand what great influencer marketing looks like and what it’s worth.

This role requires sharp talent instincts, real deal-making experience, a deep rolodex, and a creative strategic eye for the right influencers to really make campaigns pop. 

Responsibilities:

• Own influencer process end-to-end (develop strategy, write briefs, own talent relationships, manage deliverables, oversee production, drive approvals, and manage deadlines for all influencer work)

• Own creator agency relationship for XFN support across key NNIs, including always-on and campaign programs

• Make the build-versus-agency call by campaign type, and keep in-house what needs Lyft judgment

• Build the repeatable process: intake, talent vetting, rate benchmarking, brief templates, and measurement standards for both organic and paid work

• Partner with Business Affairs and Legal on contracts, usage rights, exclusivity, and disclosure compliance

• Partner closely with the rest of the Social team on quick-turn projects that support evergreen content and business priorities, especially collab posts and anything landing on Lyft's owned channels

• Build talent relationships that carry across campaigns rather than restarting each time

• Level up marketers across the org - coach DRIs on what good influencer work looks like so quality doesn't vary by team

Experience:

• 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator strategy, or paid social, with real depth on both organic creator partnerships and paid influencer activations

• Has personally negotiated influencer deals and understands how rates move with usage, exclusivity, and whether content runs organic, boosted, or as an ad

• Has managed an agency and scaled its support across multiple internal teams - not just run one account

• Fluent in how influencer creative performs both on organic feeds and as an ad unit, and how each is measured

• Operates with autonomy in an undefined space: this is a new function, and the first year is as much about building the discipline as running the campaigns

• Strong judgment on talent - brand fit, audience authenticity, and risk

• Ability to scale and distill complex social concepts to cross-functional audiences

• Global/EMEA experience a plus

Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

title: Clinic Services coordinator
description:
Who we are:
Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey - we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.
We are proud to be a certified B Corp - the first medicinal cannabis clinic in the world to achieve this recognition - reflecting our commitment to the highest standards of social and environmental responsibility.
The Role
As our Clinic Services Administrator, you'll help keep our clinic running smoothly behind the scenes. You'll own a range of key clinical admin processes, support patients where needed and complete administration tasks.
You'll work closely with our clinicians, patient support and operations teams, making sure patients get accurate, timely communication and that our clinicians can focus on care.
What you'll be doing:

• Supporting patients and clinicians across the eligibility process in line with our policies

• Preparing and issuing letters for patients where required working with clinicians to make sure they're accurate and sent on time

• Supporting clinic capacity planning making sure clinic capacity matches patient demand

• Rescheduling appointments when needed, keeping disruption for patients to a minimum

• Requesting and chasing medical records and GP summaries needed for patient assessments

• Managing the clinic admin inbox and responding to or routing clinician queries

• Keeping patient records accurate and up to date, and supporting record-keeping audits

• Tracking clinic metrics such as appointment utilisation, cancellations and non-attendance

• Supporting clinician onboarding admin, such as collecting registration, indemnity and DBS documents

• Supporting subject access requests and complaints admin, in line with our processes

• Keeping letter templates and clinic admin processes up to date, and suggesting improvements

What we're looking for:

• At least 2 years experience in an administrative role in a healthcare setting, such as a GP practice, hospital or private clinic

• Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling patient information and preparing letters

• Clear, professional written communication, and a friendly, empathetic approach with patients

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities, including short-notice changes

• A good understanding of patient confidentiality and data protection (UK GDPR)

• Confident using clinical or practice management systems, and comfortable picking up new tools

We're looking for someone who is excited to join a busy growing organisation - our team culture is based on support and respect and we take a proactive approach to employee progression and development. The ideal candidate for this role will be happy to roll their sleeves up and can take ownership of this role. In return, we offer flexible working; personalised training and development; private health insurance, Employee Assistance Programmes; access to employee perks and Releaf staff patient benefits.

Our application process starts off with an informal remote meeting followed by a written test.
At Releaf , we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences - and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Each of those engines has its own optimizer, scheduler, memory model, and exchange, and each one draws the line between "adopt your component" and "keep mine" in a different place. Nobody has settled what that integration surface should look like. That is the problem this role owns. We are looking for someone with genuine depth in how analytical data systems are built: query planning and processing, columnar and vectorized processing, storage formats, or the internals of a SQL engine.
You will work with the maintainers, architects, and engineering leaders behind these systems, in public where the project is open and directly where it is not, on how acceleration lands in what they ship. You will produce the benchmark evidence that shows whether it worked, and turn what you learn into concrete requirements for NVIDIA 's roadmap. This is a developer relations role rather than an engineering role because the leverage is breadth. An engineer improves one engine. This role shapes how acceleration lands across the ecosystem and influences which parts of it get there first.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Build and deepen technical expertise in analytical data processing, including query execution and optimization, columnar and vectorized processing, and distributed execution. Serve as a technical advocate and trusted resource for the developers building and operating these systems, working with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies such as Sirius, cuCascade, RAPIDS, cuDF, nvCOMP, and CUDA-X Data Processing.

• Demonstrate and integrate NVIDIA 's data processing stack (libraries, SDKs, and tools) into real query engines and OLAP databases, carrying the work from prototype through to a functioning, measured integration across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.

• Support developers, projects, and partners through onboarding and integration by providing working reference implementations, integration guides, and direct hands-on engineering help, so that a first integration produces a real accelerated query path rather than a demo.

• Track the analytical data processing ecosystem: new engines, execution models, storage formats, and competing approaches to acceleration. Share what you learn with NVIDIA engineering, product, marketing, and the worldwide field organization to shape adoption strategy.

• Collaborate with engine architects and NVIDIA engineering to resolve integration problems, establish best-practice patterns, and feed concrete technical requirements back to NVIDIA product teams.

• Define the integration surface between NVIDIA 's GPU data processing libraries and third-party query engines: where the plan handoff occurs, how execution and memory ownership are divided, and which of a partner's differentiating components remain in place alongside ours. Specify the APIs NVIDIA must expose to make that possible, and carry the patterns that work forward from one integration to the next.

• Own the benchmark evidence for GPU-accelerated analytics. Design and run TPC-H, TPC-DS, and ClickBench measurements against the strongest available CPU baselines, separate cold and warm behavior, and publish results that hold up to outside scrutiny. Use those results to establish where the acceleration case is proven, where it is not yet, and what has to change.

• Own the acceleration roadmap jointly with the projects and partners you work with: what gets built, in what order, and which technical bets are worth making. Earn that standing where the work happens, through upstream contribution and public design review in open source, and through joint architecture and roadmap planning with partner engineering leadership.

description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.
Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.
L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.
🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.
Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé.
Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement.
Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide.
• Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique.
• Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées.

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

- Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

- Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

- Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

- See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

- Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

- Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

- Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

title: Staff Applied Scientist, Causal Inference

Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

CAUSAL INFERENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

- Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

- Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

- Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

- Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

- Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

- Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

- Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

- Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

title: Korean Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Languages: Korean

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$65 - US$81 per hour

• Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

The Executive Director, Scientific Strategy & Evidence Sciences provides senior scientific and strategic leadership across UBC’s Evidence Development Solutions (EDS) organization. title: Data Center Generalist (m/w/d)
description:
deine aufgaben

• Du entwickelst und bewertest Rechenzentren ganzheitlich und begleitest Projekte von der Machbarkeitsstudie über Neubauten und Erweiterungen bis zur Modernisierung bestehender Standorte.

• Du verantwortest das Lösungsdesign der technischen Infrastruktur mit Fokus auf Cooling-, Power- und Facility-Konzepte. Dazu gehören luft- und wassergeführte Kühlsysteme, freie Kühlung, Cold-/Hot-Aisle-Konzepte sowie High-Density-Lösungen für AI- und GPU-Umgebungen mit Technologien wie CDUs, InRow-Systemen, Rear-Door Heat Exchangern, Direct-to-Chip- und Liquid Cooling.

• Du entwickelst und bewertest Stromversorgungskonzepte von der Netzeinspeisung bis zum Rack, inklusive USV-Systemen, Netzersatzanlagen (NEA), PDUs, Busways und Redundanzkonzepten wie N+1 oder 2N. Dabei analysierst du elektrische Infrastrukturen über alle Spannungsebenen hinweg - von Hoch-, Mittel- und Niederspannungsanlagen über Netzanschlüsse sowie Umspann- und Schaltanlagen bis zur Verteilung im White Space.

• In deinem Arbeitsalltag wendest du die DIN EN 50600 sowie relevante VDE-Bestimmungen sicher an und nutzt technische Zeichnungen wie Schaltpläne, R&I-Fließbilder sowie Layout- und Installationspläne als Grundlage für Bewertungen, Freigaben und Abnahmen.

• Du analysierst bestehende Betriebsanlagen (Schwerpunkt Brownfield), identifizierst Schwachstellen und Ausbaupotenziale und entwickelst Konzepte für Modernisierung, Erweiterung und Zukunftsfähigkeit. Hier berücksichtigst du auch bauliche und logistische Rahmenbedingungen wie Traglasten, statische Auswirkungen sowie Transport- und Einbringungskonzepte für Schwerlastkomponenten.

• Als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Generalunternehmern, Lieferanten, Planern und dem operativen Data-Center-Betrieb bewertest du technische Lösungen und Angebote, begleitest Ausschreibungen und Vergaben und unterstützt Projekte von der Planung über Bau und Inbetriebnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme.

• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Data Center Planning Team zusammen, prüfst Planungsergebnisse fachlich und stellst eine reibungslose Übergabe zwischen Konzept, Planung und Umsetzung sicher.

• Energieeffizienz, Nachhaltigkeit und Verfügbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit - von PUE-Optimierung und Ressourceneffizienz über Redundanzkonzepte bis hin zur Nutzung von Abwärme.

das bringst du mit

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Versorgungs- oder Gebäudetechnik oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation als Techniker oder Meister mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung mit.

• Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Auslegung oder technischen Bewertung von Brownfield-Projekten gesammelt und fühlst dich in komplexen Infrastrukturprojekten zuhause.

• Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Cooling-, Power- und Facility-Systeme mit und verstehst die Zusammenhänge moderner Rechenzentrumsinfrastrukturen ganzheitlich.

• Die Analyse, Erweiterung und Modernisierung bestehender Brownfield-Projekte gehört für dich ebenso zum Alltag wie die Entwicklung neuer Konzepte für zukünftige Anforderungen.

The Centralized Financial Services Officer - Packaging assists in the collection of documentation for financial aid applications along with answering questions by making outbound calls, taking inbound calls and responding to emails for both new and continuing students regarding their funding. title: Business Applications Specialist (Order to Cash)
description:
ABOUT PLEO

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Business Applications Specialist (Order to Cash) to join our Business Applications Team (BAT) at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own and grow the chain of systems that takes every deal from quote to revenue, and be part of the Business Applications Team as we scale our quote-to-cash tooling. If you're excited about managing an end-to-end set of systems as a product and are passionate about SaaS commercial operations, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll report to our Director, Business Applications and work closely with teams in Billing, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Sales. Our team of [team size] is highly collaborative and dedicated to Business Applications. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Billing, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Sales to ensure success.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Business Applications Specialist (Order to Cash), you will:

- Own the O2C portfolio. Act as product owner for the tools that support quote to cash, including HubSpot Quoting, our pricing calculator and CPQ, DocuSign and integrations with Zuora, and NetSuite.

- Set the roadmap. Build and maintain a roadmap and backlog that reflect business priorities. Think 1-2 quarters ahead and propose improvements before they become problems.

- Manage demand. Take in requests from O2C, Billing, Deal Desk, Pricing, and Sales. Assess impact, prioritise against revenue outcomes, and give stakeholders clear answers, including no.

- Design end-to-end processes. Map the lead-to-cash flow, find breaks and manual workarounds, and design solutions that hold up at enterprise scale.

- Deliver large changes. Lead medium and large enhancements from requirements through process flows, user stories, configuration, UAT, and release.

- Work with engineers. Translate business needs into clear requirements for BAT Engineering, and own functional testing and sign-off.

- Protect billing integrity. Make sure what's sold, what's contracted, and what's billed stay in sync. Treat data quality, controls, and audit trails as part of the job.

- Own vendor relationships. Manage key O2C vendors, including performance against SLAs, licence usage, and input into renewals with Procurement.

- Support tooling decisions. Contribute to evaluations of off-the-shelf CPQ and CLM options, and to buy-versus-build decisions.

- Enable and mentor. Train business users on new processes, peer review colleagues' work, and support analysts on the team.

 

To put things into context, we currently have multi-entity, multi-currency quoting and billing for enterprise contracts and the next generation of quote-to-cash tooling on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot Quoting, our pricing calculator and CPQ, DocuSign, Zuora, and NetSuite.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role

title: Software Development Engineer II (SDE-2) Backend
description:

Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're hiring an SDE-2 to own our backend end to end. You'll work on a live product, so you'll see your code in production and you'll be the one called when something breaks - we want someone who fixes the problem in front of them, then goes back and fixes why it happened. Our engineering team is in India and our stakeholders are in the US, so you'll work across both and talk to the people who make product decisions every day. The scope is wide on purpose: you'll start with the backend, and over time you can grow into platform reliability, data work, or product decisions if that's where your interest goes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own backend services: Own backend services in Python and Django REST Framework from design through production, and design new features with the technical decisions written up, including what you chose not to do and why.

- Work with PostgreSQL: Model data, dig into slow queries, pick sensible indexes, and run safe migrations on tables that are already in use.

- Run services on AWS: Deploy and run our services on AWS, keeping an eye on how they behave under load.

- Build observability: Add tracing, metrics, and logs so we can see problems before customers report them.

- Own incidents: Lead root-cause analysis on incidents, then automate the detection or fix so the same issue doesn't come back.

- Partner with US stakeholders: Clarify requirements, agree on priorities, and explain trade-offs with US stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Backend: 2+ years of backend work, comfortable with Python and Django REST Framework (viewsets, serializers, auth and permissions, background jobs) and keeping service code tidy.

- AWS: You've deployed and run real services, with experience across some of ECS, Lambda, or EC2, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS, IAM, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Tracing & observability: Hands-on with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or similar), structured logs, and dashboards (CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, or similar), and able to set alerts that people actually act on.

- Troubleshooting: You work through problems step by step - form a guess, check it with data, fix the immediate issue, then remove the cause (bonus if you've written scripts or automation that catch problems early).

- Architecture & communication: You can compare two approaches on cost, reliability, and team effort and write the decision down so others can follow it, explain a technical idea to someone who isn't an engineer, say when you disagree, and follow up on what you promised.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

- Time off: 49 days paid time off

title: Data Protection Executive
description:
📍 Lincoln Hybrid - 2 days per week in our city centre office, with 3 days working from home

Passionate about all things data protection? Looking for a role where you can take real ownership of your work and put your knowledge into practice?

We're looking for a Data Protection Executive to join our Compliance team and help ensure we're doing the right thing when it comes to handling personal data across Goodlord.

With the volume of personal data flowing through our platform, tenant referencing and insurance services, there's plenty to keep you busy!

You'll take ownership of our day-to-day data protection activities, from managing data rights requests and maintaining our records to helping colleagues across the business navigate data protection queries with confidence.

There's a task-driven element to this role, so you'll need to enjoy getting into the detail and managing a busy workload. But it's not just about ticking boxes. You'll be naturally curious, confident asking questions and keen to understand how we can improve the way we do things.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Managing data rights requests, including subject access requests, deletions and objections, ensuring they're handled accurately and within legislative timeframes.

- Providing practical data protection advice and guidance to colleagues across Goodlord, including our frontline Customer Support and Referencing teams.

- Taking ownership of our Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), working with stakeholders across the business to ensure they're accurate and up to date.

- Reviewing and maintaining our privacy notices to ensure they accurately reflect how we process personal data.

- Reviewing our existing data protection processes, ensuring we can demonstrate compliance and identifying opportunities to improve the way we do things.

- Supporting our Director of Compliance with risk assessments and the implementation of legislative changes.

ABOUT YOU

You should apply if you have:

- Hands-on, demonstrable experience in a dedicated data protection role, handling data requests, designing records of processing and having responsibility for legislative compliance.

- In-depth knowledge of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and an awareness of recent legislative developments.

- Experience managing subject access requests end to end, including the application of exemptions and redaction.

- Experience of completing data protection impact assessments and legitimate interest assessments

- Confidence working independently, prioritising your own workload and meeting legislative deadlines.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate legislative requirements into clear, practical guidance for colleagues across the business.

It would also be great if you have:

- A relevant professional qualification, such as the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection or IAPP CIPP/E.

- Experience managing personal data breaches, including assessing whether they're reportable to the ICO.

- Experience working in an FCA-regulated firm, ideally within insurance.

- An understanding of the residential lettings sector, specifically the process of tenant referencing and associated data processing activities.

We're not expecting you to know everything, but you'll need a solid grounding in data protection, the confidence to take ownership of your day-to-day responsibilities and the ability to recognise when to ask for support.
